# apple_redeliver_webhook (Action)

Sends a webhook delivery again, for example one that failed; find them with `data.apple_webhook_deliveries`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_redeliver_webhook" "last_failure" {
  config {
    delivery_id = data.apple_webhook_deliveries.failed.deliveries[0].id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `delivery_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the delivery to send again.
